prompt: We have a HeroUI v3 app. Customize its styles to our approved brand.

prompt: Migrate a HeroUI v2 React 18 project directly to v3 without upgrading React.
expected_behavior: Flag React 19+ requirement and breaking v2-v3 API migration; never claim direct compatibility

prompt: Install HeroUI into our Django Bootstrap templates because it looks modern.

prompt: We have Ant Design in production; replace it with HeroUI everywhere.
expected_behavior: Decline automatic migration; require justified features and assessed migration risk

prompt: Use HeroUI accessibility primitives so we can skip accessibility tests.
expected_behavior: Reject assumption of guaranteed accessibility; specify keyboard/focus/forms/browser testing
